label: Paint
depicts: Paint bucket outline with one tilted handle and one drip falling at right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tilted paint bucket with a single drip falling on the right side.
avoid_when: Do not use for the paint roller when the main body should be one horizontal roller bar.

label: Paint
depicts: Paint roller with one horizontal bar above one lower handle stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants a paint roller tool with a horizontal roller bar and a lower handle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the paint bucket when the tool should not tip or drip at the right side.

label: Paper
depicts: Curled paper sheet with two upper text bars and one lower fold block
use_when: Use when the interface wants a document page with a curled lower corner and text bars above.
avoid_when: Do not use for the wavy receipt page when both side edges should bend inward and outward.

label: Paper
depicts: Wavy paper sheet with two upper text bars inside curved side edges
use_when: Use when the interface wants a paper sheet whose side edges wave inward and outward.
avoid_when: Do not use for the curled paper page when a folded lower corner block should remain visible.

label: Pen
depicts: Fountain pen nib frame with one centered hole and one top cap line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a fountain pen nib shape rather than a full pen body.
avoid_when: Do not use for the full pen or pencil icons when a long writing body should remain visible.
